POC decision (2026-02-14): after a 2-week hosted test with sample traffic, product team requested Dedicated POC to evaluate reserved capacity and predictable p99/p50 under steady-state and burst loads. Decision documented in Fireflies ff_20260214_5782.
Dedicated POC scope (approved 2026-02-20):
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week canary + 2-week ramp).
- Canary: start at 5% of production chat traffic (control group), promote to 20% if SLOs met. Canary window = 72 hours for stability checks.

- Failover/fallback plan: primary = dedicated cluster (NA); fallback = Hosted API cluster in NA for cost-tier/overflow, and region failover to EU dedicated cluster for EU-customer traffic. Automated routing by region and health checks.
- Model variants: serve quantized Llama-2-derivative (fast variant) as primary, high-quality 16-bit variant as fallback for quality regressions. Lab to maintain model-variant compatibility mapping.

- Rollback triggers defined: error rate >1.0% OR p50 latency increase >150ms baseline OR hallucination-rate on eval prompts increases >8%. Rollback = immediate traffic diversion to Hosted API fallback + incident page.
- Metrics to monitor: p50/p90/p99 latency, throughput (rps), CPU/GPU utilization, per-token cost, error rate, quality regression (evaluations on canonical prompt set).
- Observability: enable token-level cost breakdown and tracing for canary traffic. Integrations requested: Datadog + internal SRE pager hooks.

Pricing conversations: procurement asked for committed monthly capacity estimate and burst pricing. Initial ARR estimate submitted to procurement: 75k-200k range. Procurement wants a 12-month reserved quote and a 3-month trial option. Drive doc contains draft pricing deck.

Technical notes from SE call (2026-02-28, ff_20260228_6019): SE Priya Kapoor reviewed batching strategies (batch size targets), KV cache suggestions for repeated prompts, and quantization profiles. Recommended continuous batching + prefix caching to hit 60-80% lower token cost for chat flows.

Hosted -> Dedicated observations during trial: Hosted API p50 ~120ms on small queries, spikes under sustained parallel sessions. Dedicated POC expected to smooth p99 and provide capacity isolation for large enterprise customers.

Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs retention 3+ years, and KMS integration for key management. EU data residency: markup required for EU-only routing. Sec team to confirm by 2026-03-12.
